source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: Where to Find the Thieves' Camp Dungeon Key
source_excerpt:
While exploring the second region, Crimson Forest, players will eventually reach the Thieves' Camp , where they can find a Crane Bell and several NPCs, some of whom are involved in side quests like Honor Among Thieves . Inside the camp, you will also find a locked door that requires the Thieves' Camp Dungeon Key , which you will not have when you first arrive.
To obtain it, you will need to explore another part of the region and find a hidden cellar. This guide covers where to find the key, how to open the dungeon, and what rewards you can collect inside.
Where to Find the Thieves' Camp Dungeon Key in Phantom Blade Zero
Image via GameRant | Sources: S-GAME
From the locked door at the Thieves' Camp, continue progressing through Crimson Forest toward the eastern side of the map until you reach the Cliffside Lodge Bell. Near this location, you will find a cellar entrance that is locked behind a crank mechanism.
To open it, make your way around the house and head upstairs to find the crank. Pick it up and use it on the mechanism to gain access to the cellar.
Once inside, you will find two paths. Ignore the path on the right, which leads to a room covered in poison, and take the left path to encounter a lone enemy. Defeat the enemy, then drop down and climb the wall on your left to reach an area with two glowing items.
The item on the right, near the chest, is the Secret Chamber Crank. The other item further ahead is the Thieves' Camp Dungeon Key. Collect both before returning to the Thieves' Camp.
What to Find Inside the Thieves' Camp Dungeon
Return to the Thieves' Camp and use the key on the locked door to enter the dungeon. Inside, you will find a wounded person on the left who needs medicine for the Healer's Mercy quest.
On the right, open the chest to collect the Ancient Crossbow, one of Zhang's treasures that you need to recover. Once you have collected it, head down the ladder and deal with the enemies below to obtain the Cave Prison Key.
Continue further ahead to find a Sha-Chi Amber Fragment. After collecting it, climb back up the ladder and use the Cave Prison Key to unlock the cell. Inside, you will find a chest containing another Sha-Chi Amber Fragment.
How to Reach the Lakeside Arch Bridge Bell
There are also two Bastion Phantom Edge points inside the dungeon. These require you to use a shield to avoid taking damage from the crossbow traps in the area.
The Bastion Phantom Edge can be unlocked in the Village of Lu , so you will need to progress further through the game before accessing this route. Once you have unlocked it, return to the dungeon and use Bastion to get past the traps below. This path leads to a golden chest containing the Brass Chest Guard accessory.
Remember that the Thieves' Camp will be a bit different in terms of the NPCs there, when you return after reaching the Village of Lu.
After collecting the accessory, head back upstairs and use Bastion at the other point to progress through the area and reach the Lakeside Arch Bridge Bell .
